sample: 32 train and 24 valid row groups, seeded uniform selection excluding conservative union of all row groups named by own saved scripts; two fixed 12-sequence validation panels

H_clock.premise: Short-history advantage may depend on quote-event count rather than elapsed rows
H_clock.event: any change in the 22 i0 price columns; first row initializes state, never an event
H_clock.rate_control: EMA64 of observed event indicator; per-row EMA alpha=1-(1-2/17)^rate; updated at every row
H_clock.fit: same 32 train sequences, rows need_prediction, separate abs(clipped target)-weighted ridge per target, clipped training response; penalty 0.001*training weighted design trace/dimension, intercept unpenalized; no validation tuning
H_clock.metric: globally pooled WP after finite-target/prediction clipping +/-2 on need_prediction AND is_scored, mean over targets
H_clock.survival: event arm exceeds both row and rate-adjusted arm by >=0.002 mean WP and has positive delta versus row in both frozen panels
H_clock.falsifier: failure of survival rule rejects advancing this specific eventEMA16 mechanism; does not reject all event-clock models
H_clock.causality: full-prefix parity at lengths 99,500,4096; future input perturbation leaves prior outputs unchanged; targets/mask absent from feature builder

H_scaling.premise: Persistent signed event increments contain ordering information beyond their marginal distribution
H_scaling.series: i0_p0 differences at quote-event rows in first 12 frozen valid groups; targets unused
H_scaling.control: 16 seeded permutations of event-increment order per sequence; same values/event count; DFA1 on scales 16,32,64,128,256,512,1024
H_scaling.survival: median original minus median shuffled slope on 16..256 >0.05 and positive in >=9/12 sequences
H_scaling.limitations: diagnostic retrospective statistic, not a feature or asymptotic Hurst proof; permutation destroys short and long dependence together

uncertainty: No row-independent significance or sequence-bootstrap campaign CI. Save per-sequence sufficient statistics; connected components unknown until controller integration. Sequence-disjoint is not necessarily campaign-unexposed or component-disjoint.

H_stationarity_followup.sample: same already-exposed first 12 continuation validation groups
H_stationarity_followup.premise: Near-zero signed increment DFA slopes can arise by telescoping a stationary encoded feature rather than exploitable market antipersistence
H_stationarity_followup.matched_control: shuffle observed event-time i0_p0 LEVELS then difference; 16 permutations per sequence; compare original differences and initial shuffled-difference null
H_stationarity_followup.survival: absolute median original minus level-shuffled DFA slope over 16..256 <0.05 supports sufficiency of stationary-level explanation, not an equivalence proof
H_stationarity_followup.synthetic_checks: iid normal increments approximately 0.5 and differenced iid normal levels approximately 0 at the same scales
H_stationarity_followup.limits: No inference about underlying raw asset price, no new holdout evidence, no claim about all 112 inputs
